about: Final calendar state for 50 real Enron threads from MailEx (Srivastava et al., EMNLP 2023, CC BY-SA 4.0), read by Claude on 2026-10-02 for Adrian to spot-check. Owner = the mailbox owner. Dates are US Central (Houston). 'on' = a meeting the owner agreed to (or proposed and they confirmed) with day and start time settled; 'ask' = agreed to meet but the day or time is not settled; 'invite' = a meeting proposed to the owner that the owner never answered; 'follow_up' = open-ended (nothing settled, or the arranging moved to a call): its own 'follow-up needed' section (Adrian, 2026-10-03); 'off' = everything else. End times are checked only where the thread states one. This file is licensed CC BY-SA 4.0.
